behavior.name: 0x13004b44
behavior.description: The center axle of a Ferris wheel. It acts as a manager that uses the 'sWheel Index's parameter to look up properties in sFerrisWheelProperties, setting its own collision and spawning four bhvFerrisWheelPlatform objects with the corresponding models and collision data.

field.name: Wheel Index
field.description: Index into sFerrisWheelProperties for axle and platform properties.
